Subject: Onboarding gate map and conditional signature plan (MSA/DPA/Order Form dependencies)

Ari —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Per our conversation I put together a concise gate map that sequences the legal and procurement milestones so we can both track who signs what and when without blocking your pilot start. Key points in the attached MAP_v2.xlsx:

- Phase A (Eval pilot): Order form + SOW signed by procurement to enable pilot provisioning.
- Phase B (Security gating): DPA + security attestation completed before production data onboarding.
- Phase C (Commercial): MSA signature or easement (redlines accepted) within 30 days of pilot acceptance; financial terms in Order Form are effective on the Order Form signature date.

Conditional approach proposed: we can accept a limited Order Form signature to provision pilot infrastructure (data segregation clause + pilot scope) and hold broader commercial terms pending MSA/DPA finalization. That reduces time-to-live pilot while protecting both sides.

Action items I propose this week:
1) Novapulse to confirm team for security questionnaire (Sofia).
2) Redwood legal (Laura) to share redline summary of MSA (attached MSA_first_redline.docx).
3) Regional procurement (Ari) to confirm payment terms we can accept for pilot order form.

If this sequencing works, we’ll add the milestones to the MAP and provide a calendar with target sign dates.

Thanks —
Markus Klein
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Markus —

This looks sensible and aligns with our internal goal: get the pilot live in July while not committing to commercial spend until security checks pass. A few clarifications from our side:

- We can sign an Order Form limited to the pilot scope and 90-day evaluation term. Payment terms: net-30 after pilot provisioning.
- DPA: we need a SOC2-equivalent summary and commitment on data retention and deletion for pilot data (we'll share our standard requirement doc).
- MSA: our legal group will review redline; prefer to have a term-sheets session next week to accelerate alignment.

Sofia will lead the security questionnaire; I've looped procurement so they can review the conditional order form language.

Ari
Head of Strategic Partnerships, Novapulse

Ari / Markus —

Thanks for the prompt read, Ari. Quick notes from legal after an initial pass of MSA_first_redline.docx:

- We can support a pilot-limited Order Form that contains: scope, pilot duration, limited liability cap for pilot, and explicit data handling constraints. The purpose is to allow provisioning without full MSA sign-off.
- DPA must be in place before any production data ingestion; for the pilot we will require an interim DPA addendum that covers retention and deletion commitments (draft attached: DPA_security_summary.pdf).
- Internal ask: Priyom, can we build a short acceptance checklist (technical + privacy checks) that maps to the Acceptance_Test_Plan.md? If we attach that to the Order Form it makes acceptance gating clear.

Proposed timeline (high level):
• 6/10 — Novapulse provides security contact and payment term confirmation.
• 6/15 — Redwood shares clean MSA redline summary and DPA addendum.
• 6/20 — Target Order Form signature (pilot provisioning).
• 7/20 — Pilot acceptance window closes (dependant on acceptance checklist).

If procurement needs different timelines we can adjust, but this sequence preserves the conditional signature approach and keeps you live.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
